facts.text: Drop Dead Ned offers himself and his killer wasp for hire at 100 gold for the week, on condition that he gets to kill people with the wasp; he would give back 5 gold for each killing he is allowed if he can do what he wants with the victims.

classification.support_basis: Hiring Ned would add a willing killer and a wasp he uses to kill things fast to the party's effort against the dragon, though nothing establishes the wasp would work on a dragon and his terms require him to kill people.
classification.action_basis: Ned explicitly offered his services and wasp for hire at a stated price, and his killing capability matches the established need to kill the dragon.
classification.opening_basis: Trigger: paying Ned 100 gold for the week and accepting his condition. Benefit: an extra killer with a fast-killing wasp toward killing the dragon. Evidence: Ned's offer (beat_21) and his description of the wasp (beat_22).
